card.name: Linking words before saline strengths
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, and, in, with) or a space right before a sodium chloride strength such as 0.9% or 0.45%. It appears in IV diluent lists and dilution instructions.

modes.label: Dextrose and saline mixes
modes.description: The word and, in or with after '5% Dextrose' just before a sodium chloride strength.
modes.example: 5% Dextrose Injection, 5% Dextrose and 0.9% Sodium Chloride Injection, 5% Dextrose<< and>> 0.45% Sodium Chlor

modes.label: Volume then diluent
modes.description: The word of after a volume in mL, before the saline strength or after a dose amount.
modes.example: Usually, 7,500 USP units of heparin sodium are added to 100 mL<< of>> 0.9% Sodium Chloride

card.writes: It promotes 'whole' and 'entirety' and suppresses 'double' and 'bi', which hints at a push away from doubled or two-part wording.
card.plain: It marks the small joining word just before a saline strength such as 0.9% or 0.45% in IV fluid names and dilution directions.
